name: card-navigator
description: Navigate your notes with a beautiful card-based interface

scripts.version: node scripts/update-version.js && git add CHANGELOG.md manifest.json versions.json
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m "chore(release): v%s" && npm run github:release $(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m "chore(release): v%s" && npm run github:release $(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m "chore(release): v%s" && npm run github:release $(node -p "require('./package.json').version")

author: wakeyi
